note: Polynomial ring over the rationals; type line auto-prints

code:
R = QQ[x,y,z]
I = ideal(x^3 - y, x^4 - z)
print generators (gb I)
note: gb I returns a GroebnerBasis in 1.26; the polynomials are seen via generators

code:
R = QQ[x,y,z]
I = ideal(x^3 - y, x^4 - z)
G = res I
print betti G
note: Graded free resolution of the (3,4) monomial-curve ideal

code:
R = QQ[x,y]
I = ideal(x^2, y^2)
print dim (quotient I)
note: Krull dimension of a zero-dimensional quotient

code:
R = QQ[x,y,z]
I = ideal(x*y, x*z)
print primaryDecomposition I
note: I = (x) cap (y,z); the package is preloaded in 1.26
Integer factorization; exponents print as raised superscript lines

code:

A = matrix(R, {{1,2},{3,4}})
print det A
